summary: Pasadena, California, works at NASA JPL, holds a PhD, expertise in robotics and distributed computing, strong interest in peer review and academic publishing, engages in long-distance running, boxing, and high-fat diet, advocates for community improvement and education, critical of political decisions affecting science funding, identifies as a skeptic of AI-driven systems, has a nuanced view on testosterone and its effects on behavior, participates in discussions about energy sustainability and environmental impact.
